text: Epic closure admits guarantees by theorem, not by solver branding. Exact spectral/global results are limited to proved special cases; convex inner problems carry exact or epsilon certificates; joint sparse-functional, generalized-loss, masked, and multiblock programs are nonconvex and publish only stationary, coordinatewise-stationary, feasible, heuristic, or unresolved outcomes justified by complete witnesses. Anchor refinement remains distinct from joint estimation.
